2866|2|4|700.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.

2866|2|4|700.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
2866|2|4|700.evidence: USI median +0.454 over 31 corners (28 understeer, 1 mid-corner front reds)

2866|2|4|700.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
2866|2|4|700.evidence: median peak rear slip 4.37; 1/1 launches spun

2866|2|4|700.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Fronts run 15 F+ hotter than rears: the understeer thermal signature — check pressures/camber on the HUD (Tires Misc + Heat).
2866|2|4|700.evidence: median F 171 F vs R 151 F

2866|2|4|700.text: Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 7 stops (0 both-axle, 1 front-first, 0 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.35) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
